Strategic objective: Replace development human tokens and add independent service identities.
Why it is not Release 1: The pilot uses a small invited group with revocable human tokens.
Trigger to revisit: Before production human access or unattended API use.

Strategic objective: Support multiple Cloud Run instances without duplicate or conflicting conversation work.
Why it is not Release 1: One Cloud Run instance and Cloud SQL meet the development pilot boundary.
Trigger to revisit: Before horizontal scaling or a production availability target.

Strategic objective: Allow safe user discovery and management while adding governed private and shared Skills.
Why it is not Release 1: Administrators can assign Public Skills for the pilot.
Trigger to revisit: When pilot demand makes manual assignment a delivery bottleneck.

Capability area: MCP security shim and delegated RBAC
Strategic objective: Propagate trusted identity to vendor MCP servers and enforce platform boundaries.
Why it is not Release 1: All pilot MCP servers and data are development-only and read-only.
Trigger to revisit: Before sensitive data or production provider access.

Strategic objective: Replace the reviewed JSON delivery mechanism with normalised immutable publications.
Why it is not Release 1: The reviewed GCS JSON snapshot is adequate for the pilot.
Trigger to revisit: When configuration scale or change frequency makes file review a bottleneck.

Strategic objective: Provide a separately deployed visual tool for creating, validating and publishing Integration definitions.
Why it is not Release 1: Authoring UI is unnecessary while JSON publication remains acceptable.
Trigger to revisit: After the relational registry and publication APIs are stable.

Strategic objective: Add controls justified by production usage and service targets.
Why it is not Release 1: Production controls require real usage and agreed service targets.
Trigger to revisit: Before general availability or when pilot evidence establishes exact limits.

Strategic objective: Add deliberate new-Goal transitions without weakening Goal evidence isolation.
Why it is not Release 1: Explicit cancel and a new conversation cover the pilot need.
Trigger to revisit: When users need to abandon a clarification-held Goal inside one conversation.
